metadata.remarks:
Identity Authentication defines the capability to verify that an entity claiming an identity is the legitimate holder of that identity at the time of access. This capability establishes proof of identity but does not make authorization decisions.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern is the authoritative anchor for roles and responsibilities, SSPPs, standards, procedures, guidelines, and assurance activities related to authentication.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Uniquely identify and authenticate organizational users.
Authenticate users and devices before granting system access.
Manage the lifecycle and protection of authenticators.

Ensure authenticated account usage supports account management.
